content: If parameter TransceiverMode of CanIf_SetTrcvMode() has an invalid value (not CANTRCV_TRCVMODE_STANDBY , CANTRCV_TRCVMODE_- SLEEP or CANTRCV_TRCVMODE_NORMAL ), the CanIf shall report development error 88 of 215 Document ID 12: AUTOSAR_SWS_CANInterface Specification of CAN Interface AUTOSAR CP R20-11 code CANIF_E_PARAM_TRCVMODE to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module, when CanIf_SetTrcvMode() is called.
